_doc: Recoil reports a signed-out reader may open at /recoil/<id>. One entry per report, added only on Zach's explicit go after a counterpart-gauntlet run on the signed-out view. Entry: {"approved": who and when, "gauntlet": the run id that cleared it, "strip_markers": optional extra lines to remove}. The public view is an allow-list (src/lib/recoilPublicShare.ts): only page blocks tagged audience "both", the page header and four meta fields; everything else never leaves the server. Pre-commit runs scripts/recoil_public_share_gate.py on every entry's signed-out render.
